item.title: 2027: I won’t leave Labour Party like Obi — Datti Baba-Ahmed
item.description: Ahead of the 2027 general elections, Senator Datti Baba-Ahmed has reaffirmed his commitment to the Labour Party (LP), insisting he remains loyal to the platform that produced him as the vice-presidential candidate in the 2023 polls. Baba-Ahmed, 56, was the running mate of Peter Obi in the last presidential election, which the LP candidate lost to Bola Tinubu of the All Progressives Congress (APC). item.title: Tinubu stood by me in my time of need, I will work for his re-election – Asari Dokubo assures Wike
item.description: Asari Dokubo, the Amanyanabo of Torusarama Piri in Degema Local Government Area of Rivers State, has pledged to support the re-election of President Bola Tinubu in 2027 for a second term. item.title: Oil price falls to $60 per barrel — below 2026 budget benchmark
item.description: Oil prices dropped on Wednesday as the market reacted to United States President Donald Trump’s announcement that the US had secured a deal to import up to $2 billion in Venezuelan crude. Brent crude dropped by 0.38 percent to $60.56 a barrel by 17.00 WAT, while US West Texas Intermediate crude fell by 1.17 percent to $56.46 a barrel. item.title: Rivers: If you don’t belong to rainbow coalition, forget 2027 election – Wike
item.description: Minister of the Federal Capital Territory, Nyesom Wike, says candidates supported by his Rainbow Coalition, made up of members of different political parties in Rivers, will win all elective positions in the state in 2027.
